generated.details: The cream ceramic coffee cup has a rounded hollow body, a loop handle attached at both ends and coffee below its rim.
The small ivory pastry plate has a shallow circular well and a gently raised rim resting on a low foot.
One croissant rests in the plate’s well, its rolled laminated body curving into tapered ends with flaky golden layers.
Its padded back and seat join over a sturdy wooden plinth.
